steps.title: Welcome to 3D!
steps.text: Hold the right mouse button in the Scene view and use WASD to fly around. Alt + drag orbits, the scroll wheel zooms, and F focuses on the selected object.

steps.title: Add a player
steps.text: Open Create > Player 3D. It comes with a CharacterController, so it already walks with WASD and jumps with Space. Press Play to try it.

steps.title: Make the camera follow
steps.text: Select the Camera, click '+ Add Component' and add CameraFollow. Drag the Player from the Hierarchy onto its Target field, set Offset to (0, 4, 7) and tick Look At Target.

steps.title: Build a level
steps.text: Create > 3D Shape > Cube adds a box. Use the gizmo to move it (W), rotate it (E) and scale it (R). Add a BoxCollider so the player can stand on it.

steps.title: Script it
steps.text: The spinning cube uses spin.es. Open it to see how rotation_y changes every frame.
